data.name: Chinonso
data.long_meaning: Chinonso is a name of Igbo origin, derived from the words chi (God) and nso (gift). It is a name that signifies divine favor and the blessings of the Almighty. The name is deeply rooted in the Christian faith and is a reminder of God's boundless love and generosity.
